name: LetterContent
description: Represents the elements of a letter created by the Letter Wizard.
remarks: Use the GetLetterContent or CreateLetterContent method to return a LetterContent object. The following example retrieves and displays the letter recipient's name from the active document. The following example uses the CreateLetterContent method to create a new LetterContent object, which is then used with the RunLetterWizard method. The CreateLetterContent method creates a LetterContent object; however, there are numerous required arguments. If you want to set only a few properties, use the New keyword to create a new, stand-alone LetterContent object. The following example creates a LetterContent object, sets some of its properties, and then uses the LetterContent object with the RunLetterWizard method to run the Letter Wizard, using the preset values as the default settings. You can duplicate a LetterContent object by using the Duplicate property. The following example retrieves the letter elements in the active document and makes a duplicate copy. The example assigns the duplicate copy to aLetter and resets the recipient's name and address to empty strings.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified LetterContent object.

properties.name: Duplicate
properties.description: Returns a read-only LetterContent object that represents the contents of a letter created by the Letter Wizard.

properties.name: DateFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets the date for a letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: IncludeHeaderFooter
properties.description: True if the header and footer from the page design template are included in a letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write Boolean. Use the PageDesign property to set the name of the template attached to a document created by the Letter Wizard.

properties.name: PageDesign
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the template attached to the document created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: LetterStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the layout of a letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write WdLetterStyle.

properties.name: Letterhead
properties.description: True if space is reserved for a preprinted letterhead in a letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write Boolean. The LetterheadSize property controls the size of the reserved letterhead space.

properties.name: LetterheadLocation
properties.description: Returns or sets the location of the preprinted letterhead in a letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write WdLetterheadLocation.

properties.name: LetterheadSize
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space (in points) to be reserved for a preprinted letterhead in a letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write Single.

properties.name: RecipientName
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the person who'll be receiving the letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: RecipientAddress
properties.description: Returns or sets the mailing address of the person who'll be receiving the letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: Salutation
properties.description: Returns or sets the salutation text for a letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: SalutationType
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of salutation for a letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write WdSalutationType.

properties.name: RecipientReference
properties.description: Returns or sets the reference line (for example, "In reply to:") for a letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: MailingInstructions
properties.description: Returns or sets the mailing instruction text for a letter created by the Letter Wizard (for example, "Certified Mail"). Read/write String.

properties.name: AttentionLine
properties.description: Returns or sets the attention line text for a letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: Subject
properties.description: Returns or sets the subject text of a letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: EnclosureNumber
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of enclosures for a letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: CCList
properties.description: Returns or sets the carbon copy (CC) recipients for a letter created by the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: ReturnAddress
properties.description: Returns or sets the return address for a letter created with the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: SenderName
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the person creating a letter with the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: Closing
properties.description: Returns or sets the closing text for a letter created by the Letter Wizard (for example, "Sincerely yours"). Read/write String.

properties.name: SenderCompany
properties.description: Returns or sets the company name of the person creating a letter with the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: SenderJobTitle
properties.description: Returns or sets the job title of the person creating a letter with the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: SenderInitials
properties.description: Returns or sets the initials of the person creating a letter with the Letter Wizard. Read/write String.

properties.name: InfoBlock
properties.description: Associated with the Letter Wizard in Microsoft Word. Not used in the U.S. English version of Word.

properties.name: RecipientCode
properties.description: Returns or sets the recipient code. Read/write String.

properties.name: RecipientGender
properties.description: Returns or sets the recipient's gender, if known. Not used in the U.S. English version of Microsoft Word. Read/write WdSalutationGender.

properties.name: ReturnAddressShortForm
properties.description: Returns or sets the short form address. Read/write String.

properties.name: SenderCity
properties.description: Returns or sets the sender's city. Not used in the U.S. English version of Microsoft Word. Read/write String.

properties.name: SenderCode
properties.description: Returns or sets the sender code. Not used in the U.S. English version of Microsoft Word. Read/write String.

properties.name: SenderGender
properties.description: Returns or sets the gender used with the salutation. Not used in the U.S. English version of Microsoft Word. Read/write WdSalutationGender.

properties.name: SenderReference
properties.description: Not used in the U.S. English version of Microsoft Word. Read/write String.
